title: Audit Karabiner config and migrate generic remaps out of raw JSON
description: Review the current Karabiner setup and reduce raw karabiner.json maintenance. Produce a rule-by-rule split across: Keep in Karabiner GUI, Move to Kanata, Move to app settings or automation, Delete. Prioritize moving generic keyboard semantics such as Hyper Caps, right_cmd navigation, right_cmd+space, and similar non-Apple-specific logic into a simpler authoring format or Kanata. Keep Apple-specific function-key, fn/globe, and device-specific behavior in Karabiner unless there is a clearly better owner. Clean up dead or experimental rules along the way.

title: Audit home directory bloat safely
description: Inventory /Users/ivan for large or suspicious directories, verify ownership and references before cleanup, and record safe cleanup candidates without deleting anything unverified.

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
comments.text: Read-only home audit on 2026-04-30/May 1: /Users/ivan totals about 1.1T. Biggest buckets: Library 299G, proj 247G (235G viofo), VIDEO 233G, Music 114G, Trash 74G, .cache 32G, Downloads 30G, .archive 29G, media 25G, .config 12G. High-confidence reclaim candidates: empty Trash 74G; review/delete old Downloads installers/archives about 25G; Homebrew downloads cache 10G but brew cleanup dry-run errors on broken dicklesworthstone/tap/bv formula; uv cache 24G (official cache); whisper cache 5.8G; npm cache 7.4G but npm verify hit EPERM/root-owned-style warning; Colima not running and uses 11G; Docker Desktop data 14G; UTM VMs 82G; Muse Hub downloads 32G; Audacity OpenVINO models 25G; MobileSync device backup 23G; .archive/tails.img 29G not referenced by UTM configs found.

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
comments.text: Phase 1 cleanup run on 2026-05-01: uv cache prune removed 540,917 files / 19.6GiB; Trash emptied through Finder after rm hit macOS protected app-bundle permissions; removed ~/.cache/whisper; removed ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew/downloads; removed top-level Downloads installer/archive files matching .dmg/.iso/.7z/.tar.gz. Verification: ~/.Trash 0B, ~/.cache/uv 3.2G remaining, Downloads 9.4G remaining. User clarified main goal is top-level folder count, not disk size; baseline remains 128 top-level directories, 37 visible and 91 hidden.

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
